notes.title: 07/30 (Tue) Update - Temporary Measures for Crawling Queen Issue
notes.content:
Users reported bugs where the level could not be cleared or the Crawling Queen did not appear on the 35th floor because there was only one Biodol left.
Unfortunately, our team of 3 tested it several times with various special upgrades, but we were unable to reproduce the issue.
We also patched the expected parts, but it seems to have no effect.
For now, we have temporarily updated the game so that the door opens after 10 seconds when there is only one Biodoll left, allowing you to clear the game.
If you tell us more about the situation when the bug occurs, it will be helpful in finding and fixing the problem.
We apologize for any inconvenience caused to users due to our inexperience.
We will work harder to provide a more pleasant gameplay environment.
Thank you for playing.

notes.title: 07/12 (Fri) Update - Equipment save system / Special upgrades added

○ New features
- When you clear the game, you will be able to keep all the selected equipment.

- You can spend points to apply additional options to equipment in the Test Room. (Consumes 1,000 points / requires clearing Crawling Queen mode)

○ Special upgrades
▽ Barrage (HG)

-Bullet spreads considerably.

▽ Matryoshka Shell (SR)
SR attacks inflict damage 3 times.
Total damage does not change.

▽ Burning shell (SG)
Shooting cooldown +3 seconds, leaves a burning area around when shooting.
The burning area lasts for 10 seconds and deals 10 damage per second to enemies within the range.

○ Changes
- You can earn points by disassembling unique or higher equipment. (Unique: 100 points / Legendary: 300 points)
- In Crawling Queen mode, max item options increase.
- Start with the equipment saved in the test room.
- Modified to start with 1 grenade when selecting grenade talents
- Modified the knife damage upgrade to appear as a normal upgrade.

○ Bug fixes
- Fixed an issue where HP was recovered when damage below the shield value was inflicted on the Crawling Queen.
- Fixed an issue where the recovery value did not increase when the knife durability recovery attribute increased knife durability during game play.
- Fixed an issue where the durability of a knife that had been used up was restored when replacing the knife.
- Fixed an issue where the character's abilities increased 2-3 times in boss battles

※ Thank you to Patreon users who helped with the beta.

○ Add elite biodolls
- Elite versions of Dummy Doll / Spare Doll / Combined Dummy Doll / Levitation / Temptation / Enhancer / Sentinel / Crusher are added.
- Elite biodolls appear in Crawling Queen mode and have higher stats than normal biodolls.
- Elite Biodoll's minimum armor is 2.
- Elite Temptation's shock defense is 7 times, not 5.
- Elite Sentinels receive 1/4 the stagger of normal Sentinels.
- Elite Biodolls appear with a 10% chance when spawning Biodolls.
- If you put an elite biodoll in the biodoll chamber, the higher option will be activated.
- 8 types of elite biodoll game over images have been added.

○ Add and modify special upgrades
▽ Electronic Grenade Supply
- One electronic grenade is supplied per round.
- Grenade inflicts 100 damage ignoring armor.

▽ Strong Man (Knife)
- The issue where the “Strong Man (Knife)” special upgrade was not appearing will be fixed.
※ After the last update, this feature was disabled for some reason. we're sorry.

○ Add map
- Added 2 new maps (medium sized maps)

○ Improvement
- Resolved the issue where the Sentinel and Temptation priority was set high when attacking with a knife.
- Modified supply-related special upgrades to apply to continuing rounds.
- Added option to prevent the screen from turning gray even when HP decreases (Gameplay → Convenience feature → Screen effect according to HP)
-Improved knife attack judgment + increased basic knife attack range
- Modified to display only points earned in the results window


○ Bug fixes
- Fixed an issue where the Crawl Queen’s attack effect remained.
- Fixed an issue where the Sentinel's shield could be removed by right-clicking the dance gun.
- Fixed an issue where the Biodoll's AI would stop working when performing a dance with a dance gun and then canceling it again.
- In the round upgrade, the locations of the knife durability increase option and the knife attack power increase option are exchanged.
